About.title: About the Project
About.courseDescription: This application is created as part of the RS School React course. The task focuses on building a full-stack React application with authentication, OpenAPI editing, API testing, request history, analytics, internationalization, and SSR.
About.projectDescription: Swagger Editor App combines a Swagger/OpenAPI editor, API documentation viewer, and REST client in one interface. Users can edit API specifications, inspect endpoints, execute requests through the server, and review request history.
About.memberRole: Solo developer: architecture, UI, authentication, OpenAPI editor, REST client, history, analytics, tests, and deployment.
About.technologies: Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, next-intl, Supabase, React Hook Form, Yup, Vitest, Vercel.
